      Country Home And Wooded Acreage In Graves County, KY

      2446 State Route 534 Symsonia, KY 42082

      Get Directions
      Save

      Media

      Listing Gallery

      Description

      Located in a quiet rural area of Graves County, Kentucky, this home and acreage offer a comfortable country setting with wooded land, a small pond, and opportunities for deer and turkey hunting. With a manageable home, plenty of outdoor space, and convenient access to nearby public recreation, the property is well-suited for anyone looking for a rural residence with room to enjoy the outdoors. The 1,100-square-foot home features three bedrooms and one bathroom, with an open kitchen and living area that create a comfortable central gathering space. The practical floor plan makes good use of the available square footage while providing plenty of flexibility for everyday living. An attached garage provides convenient vehicle and equipment storage, while a covered front porch offers a shaded place to relax and enjoy the country setting. Outside, the home is surrounded by a spacious yard with mature shade trees and a gravel driveway providing access and parking. Beyond the homesite, the property transitions into wooded acreage that adds privacy and recreational appeal. The timber provides natural habitat and cover for local wildlife, while a small pond adds another habitat feature and water source to the property. The combination of wooded acreage, water, and surrounding rural habitat creates opportunities for both deer and turkey hunting. The property is also located close to Kaler Bottoms Wildlife Management Area, providing convenient access to additional public land and outdoor recreation. Approximately 400 feet of road frontage provides access to the property while maintaining the quiet country atmosphere. For buyers seeking an affordable country home with acreage, hunting opportunities, and room to enjoy the outdoors, this Graves County property offers a practical blend of residential and recreational features.
